skills.name: vellum
skills.description: Local design-iteration skill — a self-hosted alternative to SuperDesign. Generates static HTML/CSS mockups using YOUR codebase's design tokens, Tailwind config, and shadcn/ui class vocabulary. No paid service, no account, no remote API. Files live in `.claude/designs/` in the repo. Verbs: init, create, draft, iterate (replace|branch), open, list. Invoke with `/vellum <verb> <args>` or call directly when the user asks to mock up, sketch, prototype, or iterate on UI.
headings: Phase 2 — out of scope for MVP
